lines: The gear took the blow that would have reached me.
I needed it, and it held.
That protection bought me enough time to get clear.
The straps stayed tight through the whole fight.
I trusted the gear only after trouble tested it.
There is a fresh mark where it saved my shoulder.
It did its work while I was too frightened to think.
I came home because this did not fail.
The damage looks worse than the wound beneath it.
I will clean it before rust settles in.
That gift became protection at exactly the right moment.
It turned a hard strike into a bruise.
I heard the impact and expected much worse.
The fit was right, even while I was running.
I owe this gear careful repairs.
It kept my hands free when I needed a remedy.
I was able to help someone else because I stayed protected.
The buckle bent, but it never opened.
This has earned a permanent place by my bed.
Thank you. I know precisely what this spared me.
I have not needed the gear yet, and I am grateful for that.
It remains ready beside my bed.
The straps fit well after a small adjustment.
I cleaned it even though it has seen no trouble.
Knowing it is there helps me sleep.
I hope it stays untested for a long time.
The gear is sound and properly stored.
I tried the weight before putting it away.
Nothing has struck it, scratched it, or tested the buckles.
I would rather report dust than damage.
It gives me one less thing to fear on night watch.
I keep it close when the raid horn might sound.
The fit leaves enough room to reach my bottles.
I checked every fastening twice.
It has not saved me yet, but it has steadied me.
Good protection can do useful work before a fight begins.
I am ready to wear it if the bell rings.
The gear waits more patiently than I do.
No repairs are needed.
Thank you. I hope my next report is equally uneventful.
